name: Do I need to hire a plumber or electrician for countertop replacement?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a plumber or electrician for countertop replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most countertop replacement projects, you will likely need a plumber to disconnect and reconnect your sink, faucet, and any other water-related appliances. If your project involves moving or installing new appliances like cooktops, an electrician might be necessary to handle electrical connections. While some general contractors include these services, it's essential to clarify this upfront. Frasheski Construction coordinates all necessary trades, including plumbing and electrical, to ensure a seamless and compliant installation process for our clients in Berkeley and surrounding areas, meaning you often won't need to hire them separately.
acceptedAnswer.description: A plumber is often needed for sink/faucet disconnection/reconnection. An electrician may be needed for cooktop or appliance changes. Frasheski Construction coordinates these trades.
